'''Gungus Boga''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Heralds of Zildrog]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]]. By [[3630 BBY]], he became known as the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] "'''Noble Executioner'''" in the [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Boga was put up against a newcomer known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]." During the fight in the Arena, Gungus was assisted by several of his fellow Heralds of [[Zildrog]], but was defeated in the third round of the Arena fights.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gungus Boga first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as the third boss of the Eternal Championship event.

Boga's mask resembles that of the [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] featured in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''.<ref name="TSL">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>
